sections_en.text: Introduction

This document sets out the calibration steps I1 to be carried out annually on the gas circuit of the gas turbine, as indicated by the code Y1 above. The first draft of this document was prepared by Eng. Doaa Mohamed Shabana, field-tested by Eng. Marwa El-Sayed El-Hadidy, endorsed by General Manager Eng. Yousry Ahmed Abdel Maksoud, reviewed by Eng. Abdel Monem El-Emam, Manager of the Instruments and Electricity Department in the Inspection Sector of the East Delta Electricity Production Company, and approved by Eng. Fathy Mahmoud Ragab, Head of the Talkha Gas Turbine Station Sector.

It was endorsed by Eng. Samir Abdel Galil, General Manager of Inspection and Quality at the East Delta Electricity Production Company and MPIS Coordinator, and approved by Mr. Mahmoud Mohamed Sleiman, General Manager of Financial and Administrative Control and Supervisor of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector.
Safety precautions

items: Issue a work order, with an industrial safety category card available for the site workers
Fence off the area and use the appropriate warning signs
Use occupational safety and health equipment such as a safety helmet and safety shoes, etc.
The unit must be shut down and stopped before starting the maintenance work

sections_en.text: Tools and equipment used
Frequency measuring instrument, oil pump calibration set
2 digital voltmeters, occupational safety and health equipment

rows:
Connect the calibrator to:
أ - Connector A on Red Slot
in x1L7X
ب - Connector B on Blue Slot
in x1L7X
Make sure that the control valve is closed and that the hydraulic oil pressure is zero
Make sure that the clearance is between 30 and 50 thou for the gas control valve

sections_en.text: Calibration of the oscillator
أ Oscillator No. (1):

rows: Connect the voltmeter lead to pin (45) on the SOSG card in x1LOE and the other lead to earth A com
Adjust the voltage and frequency to the calibrated value (measurement can be taken from the calibrator) [A09R26] A com &.

sections_en.text: ب Oscillator No. (2):

rows: Connect the voltmeter lead to pin (45) on the SOSG card in x1LOG and the other lead to earth A com, and adjust the voltage and frequency to the calibrated value (measurement can be taken from the calibrator) [A10R28] A com &
If adjustment to the values in the table is not possible, replace the SOSG card with a new one and repeat the calibration.

sections_en.text: Calibration of the LVDT (output) for each of x96SR, 96GC1,2):

rows: Calibrate the P2 pressure transducer (96FG) as follows:
Take this reading from (JB 25) or from LCTB1

sections_en.text: Determining the two ends of the control valve stroke:

rows: Start the unit in CRANK mode to obtain hydraulic oil pressure; the gas valve must be closed
Make a jumper on J2, J1 on the face of the SSVG card
Set the VCE value to Max by making a jumper between pin D10y and pin Acom on the calibrator
Connect the voltmeter to (A com & F11Y) & (A com & G12Y) on the calibrator, or between (A com & Out 1, A com & Out 1) & (A com & Out 2) on the face of the SSVG card, to read the servo valve voltage
Connect the voltmeter to measure VCE between pin H07, Acom on the calibrator
Match the following table, noting that the required VCE value is changed from the variable resistance on the SSKC card in x1L1T:
To test the LVDT fault circuit, remove the SOSG card in x1LOE; a 'Position Servo Trouble' alarm appears
To test the fault circuit of the servo valve, make a jumper between Out1 and Out2 and Acom on the face of the card; a 'Position Servo Trouble' alarm appears and the red lamp on the SSVF card lights
Remove the jumper between Out1 or Out2 and Acom
Disconnect all connections and device leads and stop the diesel

sections_en.text: Adjusting the stroke of the stop and speed ratio valve (VSR):

rows: Make sure the stop and speed ratio valve is closed and the hydraulic pressure is zero, and make sure the clearance is within 30 to 50 thou
Measure the output of x96SR from the adjacent box JB25 between the blue and yellow wires No. 3, 4 on the terminal block
Adjust the Stability from R98 (2) on the SSVD card by turning counter-clockwise 3 turns
Remove the gas control card SSVG from its place (control valve)
Start the unit in CRANK mode
Make a jumper between J1, J2 on the face of the SSVD card
Set VCE to the MAX. value by making a jumper between Acom, D10y on the calibrator
Connect the voltmeter to measure the servo voltage x90SR between pins (A com & G13Y) & (A com & G14Y)
Energize the solenoid valve x20FG manually, or make a jumper on the valve control points on page x20F between [RTB2S (4) & RTB 3Q (2)] - [RTB 3S (2) & RTB 3Q (1)]
Adjust the VCE corresponding to the valve stroke as per the following table, noting that the required VCE value is changed from the variable resistance on the SSKC card in (1L1T):
To test the LVDT fault circuit, take the SOSG card out of its place; a 'Position Servo Trouble' alarm appears on the alarm panel, then return the card to its place.
Trip the unit manually via (12 HA) Mech. Overspeed; the stop and speed ratio valve is observed to close
Disconnect all connections and return the cards to their places.

sections_en.text: Calibration of the governing pressure P2:

rows: Make sure the hydraulic oil pressure is zero and the stop and speed ratio valve is closed.
Disconnect the wires of the 96FG transducer from the adjacent box (JB25)

Simulate the transducer output with VCE values by making a jumper between pin (H07R) and PFG (C03R) on the calibrator panel, measure the voltage, and connect the voltmeter between pin (H07R) and earth A com.
Simulate the turbine speed NHP using an oscillator and a frequency counter by making a jumper between Freq. Source (C01), NHP (B02)
Connect the Freq. Count pins between B02, Acom.
Connect a voltmeter between pin 45 of the SSVD card and Acom (TRD signal).
Make a jumper to cut off firing by placing Logic 0 on pin x38 on the SSVD card so that the pressure governor can perform its function
Remove the SSVG card to prevent the control valve from opening.
Adjust the VCE voltage (transducer output) as per the following table:
Disconnect all the above connections, return the cards to their places, and make sure there are no alarms and that the turbine is Ready
